user.title: Set up Gmail IMAP
user.description:
Enter your Gmail address. You will be redirected to Google to authorise access.

Before continuing, ensure IMAP is enabled in your Gmail settings and you have configured an OAuth2 application with the Gmail IMAP scope.

auth.title: Authorise with Google
auth.description: Click the link below to grant Home Assistant access to your Gmail via IMAP.

settings.title: Mailbox settings
settings.description: Choose which folder to monitor and how often to poll.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Google
reauth_confirm.description: Your Gmail authorisation has expired or been revoked. Click Submit to re-authenticate with Google.

abort.already_configured: This Gmail address is already configured.
abort.missing_credentials: No application credentials found. Add them under Settings → Devices & Services → ⋮ → Application Credentials.
abort.oauth_error: An OAuth2 error occurred. Check that your OAuth2 client ID and secret are correct under Settings → Devices & Services → ⋮ → Application Credentials.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: Google rejected the authorisation. Ensure your OAuth2 app has the Gmail IMAP scope and your account is added as a test user.
abort.oauth_failed: Could not obtain an OAuth2 token. Try removing and re-adding the application credentials, then set up again.

add_search_sensor.title: Add email search sensor
add_search_sensor.description: The sensor counts matching UIDs on the server without fetching message bodies. Populated filters combine with AND.

error.invalid_search_filters: One or more search filters are invalid. Remove control characters and use valid dates.

abort.too_many_search_sensors: The maximum of 20 email search sensors has been reached.

query_emails.name: Query emails (legacy)
query_emails.description: Backwards-compatible IMAP search action. New automations should use Find emails.

search_emails.name: Search emails (advanced IMAP)
search_emails.description: Search using raw standard IMAP SEARCH criteria. For ordinary automations, use Find emails.

find_emails.name: Find emails
find_emails.description: Find messages with UI-friendly filters that combine using AND.

get_message.name: Get message
get_message.description: Retrieve bounded readable content for a folder-specific message UID.
